text:
elaine (docs): Heads-up — planning deprecation note for v1 API + model-swap guidance. Want to land a short migration guide and a lightweight shim example in the SDKs. Timeline: announce in 2 weeks, deprecate in 90 days after announcement. Thoughts?

sam (eng-runtime): 👍 timeline sounds fine. We should expose a graceful fallback in serving that returns a 302 -> /v2 to avoid immediate failures for edge cases.

priyanka (sdk): We can't 1:1 map v1 client calls to v2 because response shapes changed. I'll prepare a compatibility wrapper in the JS/TS SDK that does minimal coercion. PR incoming: #3421 — will export `createCompatClient()`.

james (product): Make sure the deprecation notice appears in Console, Billing emails, and the in-app banner. Add an FAQ on pinned models and Dedicated customers.

elaine (docs): Drafting a PR checklist for docs so reviewers know what's required:
- migration walkthrough with examples for text generation, chat, and embeddings
- explicit code diffs showing v1 -> v2 changes
- a short shim example for each SDK (TS/py)
- a table mapping common fields (prompt -> input, model -> model_id, stop_sequences -> stop)
- callout about streaming differences and perf implications
- redirects for old docs URLs and a changelog entry

priyanka (sdk): Example snippet I'll add to the SDK PR: 
```js
// v1 -> v2 shim (minimal)
import { RedwoodV2 } from '@redwood/sdk'
export function createCompatClient(apiKey){ 
  const c = new RedwoodV2({ apiKey })
  return {
    generate: (opts) => c.responses.create({ ...opts, endpoint: 'text.generate' })
  }
}
```

elaine (docs): @priyanka please also add the mapping table in the docs page; I'll draft the prose and put code diffs inline. I'll link to your PR once it exists.

sam (eng-runtime): One caveat: v1 used a slightly different streaming token API; shimming streaming will have perf and latency differences. Let's add a short benchmark note so customers understand trade-offs.

docs-bot: Reminder: add deprecation banner on docs site via /admin Banners. Ticket: INF-781 (assigned docs).

james (product): Coordinate launch with ops so console banner + email + in-app message go live same day. Target date for announcement: 2026-06-10.

elaine (docs): I'll open the docs PR today and assign reviewers @sam and @priyanka. ETA for docs PR: EOD tomorrow. I'll post the PR link and the announcement copy here when ready.

priyanka (sdk): Noted — I'll try to land #3421 and add unit tests that mirror v1 responses so we can link to them from the migration guide.

sam (eng-runtime): If you want a temporary redirect deployed, ping me when PRs are ready and I'll wire it into integration tests.

elaine (docs): Thanks everyone — will follow up in this thread with the PR + announcement draft.
